lesson_title: Seven Things Every Living Thing Does
hook_text: A baobab tree and a springbok look nothing alike. So why do we say they are both alive?
clip_script: School garden hunt in Polokwane! A tree, a beetle, a worm, a weaver bird, a lizard, mushrooms. All alive. But how do we know? Every living thing does seven things. Feed. Grow. Reproduce. Breathe. Excrete. Sense. Move. Count them on your fingers! And the tree? It makes food in its leaves, breathes through tiny holes, makes seeds, and turns slowly to the light. All seven. Plants are alive too, just quiet about it.
visual_style: Whiteboard school garden with a tree, a beetle, a bird and a mushroom; seven life-process icons light up one by one around a learner.
mood: Curious and lively, like a treasure hunt in the garden.
pacing: A quick hunt for living things, then the seven processes counted off on fingers, then the surprise that plants do all seven.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find three living things outside your classroom.
